wins.text: Q4 U.S. commercial revenue grew 70% YoY and 12% sequentially to $131M; full year U.S. commercial revenue grew 36% YoY to $457M
Q4 commercial TCV booked was $699M — highest commercial TCV quarter in company history — up 156% YoY and 74% sequentially
Adjusted operating margin expanded to 34% in Q4, fifth consecutive quarter of expansion; Rule of 40 score jumped 800 bps sequentially to 54
Generated $305M in adjusted free cash flow in Q4 (50% margin) and $731M for full year; fifth consecutive quarter of GAAP profitability with $210M full-year GAAP net income
U.S. commercial customer count grew 55% YoY and 22% sequentially to 221 customers; closed 103 deals over $1M in Q4 alone, including multiple deals over $25M each

risks.text: U.S. government revenue grew only 6% YoY and 3% sequentially to $237M in Q4, described as 'muted' due to continuing resolution and timing of large contract awards
Revenue from strategic commercial contracts expected to decline from ~4% of 2023 revenue to ~2% of 2024 revenue, with Q1 2024 contribution dropping to $14-16M from $33M in Q1 2023
International commercial revenue grew only 11% YoY vs. 70% for U.S. commercial; management acknowledged Europe is 'not going to engage in this revolution'
Management acknowledged need to rebuild internal go-to-market infrastructure and scale sales force to meet AIP demand — execution risk in rapid scaling
DoD monetization of battlefield AI deployments (Israel, Ukraine, CENTCOM) expected to take time; Army spending only 0.015% of budget on C2 software in FY24

guidance_items.detail: Q1 2024 revenue guided to $612M-$616M; full year 2024 revenue guided to $2.652B-$2.668B (vs. $2.23B in 2023, implying ~19% growth)
U.S. commercial revenue guided to exceed $640M in 2024, representing at least 40% growth YoY
Full year 2024 adjusted income from operations guided to $834M-$850M, implying ~31-32% margin vs. 28% in 2023
Adjusted free cash flow guided to $800M-$1B for full year 2024
GAAP operating income and net income expected in each quarter of 2024, extending streak of GAAP profitability

analyst_concerns_not_in_prepared: Whether AIP customer engagement is accelerating into early 2024 (not proactively quantified in prepared remarks)
DoD software procurement pace and Palantir's competitive advantage vs. defense primes pivoting to software
FedStart program traction and timeline for Apollo to become a significant revenue contributor
